scope: Bounded exploratory conditional-HMC stability diagnostic after the failed prior-predictive pilot; not new posterior chains
seed: 0x5600000000000000 | mock_id<<32 | ensemble<<30 | draw<<8 | trial; shared standardized momenta across cases
source_checks: Native predictions/quadratics reproduce each saved state; eight derivative directions per state; trial 0 of every case/state matches the ordinary sampler exactly
limits: Same frozen data, priors and field states; scalar parameters held fixed during each conditional trajectory
Current-scalar metric stays fixed throughout each trajectory; no field-dependent mass or Riemannian approximation
All cases have integration time 1.2 but different gradient costs; report accepted jump squared per gradient evaluation
Inputs are correlated stored states from an already examined pilot, including failed chains; no mixing/coverage claim
Only cold-state neighborhoods sampled, not a reconstruction of every historical divergent trajectory
No production defaults changed, chains extended, source states modified or failed inputs replaced
